sw_notes: qwen35_397b_grpo_trtllm-arm:20261013 (NeMo-RL, Megatron-Bridge, TRT-LLM), NVIDIA shipped config_GB300_64x4_t32g32_tp4pp2ep32gtp4_mxfp8.sh with the GB200 overrides in config_GB200_64x4_t32g32_tp4pp4cp2ep32gtp4_mxfp8_offload.sh (32 training nodes TP 4, PP 4, CP 2, EP 32, ETP 1, sequence parallel, micro-batch 1, routed-expert MXFP8 with BF16 Adam state, selective recompute with norm offload, chunked optimizer-state CPU offload with fraction 1.0 and 256 MiB chunks; 32 generation nodes as single-node TRT-LLM TP 4 EP 4 engines; GBS 512 = 32 prompts x 16 generations, 4 NeMo-Gym replicas), launched with submit.sh (config_site.sh, job.sub). config_GB200_64x4_t32g32_tp4pp4cp2ep32gtp4_mxfp8_offload.sh, the config_filename recorded in the logs, sources config_site.sh, which the runs used directly. Each trial's seed is drawn once on the login node from the operating-system randomness source (Python secrets.randbelow, distinct per trial) and passed to run.sub as TRIAL_SEEDS; run.sub validates the plan and the benchmark logs the seed used. Two image modules are replaced by read-only mounts at start (config_mounts.sh): mlperf_lazy_dataset.py (dataset identity without the stat.st_dev check on the NFS mount) and swe_agents_app.py (NeMo-Gym SWE sandbox launch without a nested --pid namespace); run.sub assigns compact positive Ray topology ranks. Validation pass@4 >= 0.69. The launcher did not export MLPERF_SUBMISSION_ORG or MLPERF_SUBMISSION_PLATFORM, so the image's mlperf_common logged the placeholder values SUBMISSION_ORG_PLACEHOLDER and 64xSUBMISSION_PLATFORM_PLACEHOLDER for submission_org and submission_platform; the result logs are the complete per-run logs as produced, with only the tenant home directory and user name redacted. The submitter is CoreWeave and the system is CoreWeave_GB200_64x4_ngc2608 (64 nodes x 4 GPUs).
